name: Input Buffer
description: If you click shortly before landing, the click is remembered and fired the moment you touch the ground.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: How long before landing a click is remembered. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS (240 ticks = 1 second).
